why: Statistical monitors are not assertions, and this toolkit's skill says so: some deviation is normal. A table dropping sharply on a Saturday is the single most common false positive a volume monitor produces, and a monitor that always warns and is never acted on is worse than no monitor — it trains the team to ignore the channel that will one day carry a real failure.
